Summary
: The English translation of the Mundaka Upanishad (Mundakopanishad) including the commentary of Madhva called the Bhasya. It is associated with the Atharva Veda and contains three parts having two section each. The text discusses the science of knowledge, the knowledge of Brahman, the self and the soul.
The Mundaka Upanishad is also known as: Muṇḍaka Upaniṣad (मुण्डक उपनिषद्), Muṇḍakopaniṣad (मुण्डकोपनिषद्), Mundakopanisad, Muṇḍakopaniṣat (मुण्डकोपनिषत्), Mundakopanisat or Mundakopanishat.
